# Draft:BET Hip Hop Award for Single of the Year

The BET Hip Hop Award for Song of the Year (Called Track of the year from 2006-2016, and then Single of the Year from 2017-2019) is an award presented to recording artists for quality singles at the BET Hip Hop Awards. It was originally titled Track of the Year, but it was changed during the (2017) ceremony.
